intro: Across 14 articles published between 12 April and 5 October 2026, ZCyberNews tracked high-severity incidents affecting healthcare, with LockBit, Booba, and Interlock each appearing among the most-covered threat actors. Reporting spanned the United States, Global, North America, Canada, and Illinois, reflecting the geographic reach of these campaigns. Affected sectors included healthcare, Healthcare, critical infrastructure, education, and financial services. Of the covered incidents, 11 were rated high severity and one medium, underscoring the concentration of serious activity targeting medical providers and connected systems throughout the period.
